about.en:
SOPRO – Solidariedade e Promoção is a non-profit organisation based in Barcelos, in the north of Portugal. For 30 years, we have worked in solidarity, volunteering, education, and community participation, guided by our motto "Small gestures change the world." Volunteering Footprint is a 75-day project that aims to create a meaningful opportunity for young people, particularly those with fewer opportunities. As a volunteer, you will join our team and actively contribute to our day-to-day work, both at SOPRO and with our partner organisations. A large part of your time will be spent with elderly people who live alone or feel isolated (visiting them, talking, organising activities and keeping them company). You will also support other SOPRO initiatives, such as food collection campaigns, preparing food baskets for local families, sorting books for our international projects in Mozambique, garden maintenance and leading awareness sessions in schools on interculturality, human rights and volunteering (for example).

Practical details: European Solidarity Corps individual volunteering hosted by SOPRO - Solidariedade e Promoção ONGD in Barcelos, Portugal; activity period 11 weeks within 1 October 2026 – 31 December 2027. Themes: social inclusion and environment and nature. Application deadline: 30 June 2027. Open to young people aged 18–30 resident in 25 eligible countries (see eligibility).

Living and learning: Volunteers will live in a shared house in Barcelos alongside other volunteers, in shared triple rooms. The accommodation includes a fully equipped kitchen, a washing machine, internet access and a common living room. Participants will prepare their own meals in the shared kitchen, supported by a monthly allowance of €300 (€120 for food allowance and €180 for pocket money). As in every ESC placement, volunteers receive insurance, pre-departure and on-arrival training, a mentor, language support and a Youthpass certificate.

about.en:
Eduact organizes workshops for kids to participate actively and design a robotics program based on their own needs. By doing so we are giving another approach of the educational process and an opportunity for the kids to use their knowledge in a practical way. The workshops run by young trainers, familiar with technology, with the ability to approach knowledge through informal education. Moreover we use hands on activities in which, educators, kids and parents, create together and unfurl their imagination. One of the main priorities of Eduact is to provide equal opportunities for learning to any individual. We give the chance to refugees, children from minorities and children with disruptive behavior, young inmates and young people who are facing social exclusion to participate in innovative educational programs. Volunteer will mainly support the communication department for the organisation and promotion of the activities as well as the dissemination of the results.

Practical details: European Solidarity Corps individual volunteering hosted by Δραση ΓΙΑ ΤΗΝ Εκπαιδευση in Thessaloniki, Greece; activity period 34 weeks within 15 November 2026 – 15 July 2027. Themes: social inclusion and education and training. Application deadline: 10 November 2026. Open to young people aged 18–30 resident in 25 eligible countries (see eligibility).

Living and learning: Volunteers are going to be accommodated in a fully equipped building located in the city centre, near the main bus and train station of the city. It is an autonomous 5 floored building of 150 m2 per floor and a terrace on the 6th floor. Volunteer will share the room with 1-3 roommates. We provide our volunteers with three meals per day through a catering service that prepares the food according to their preferences and allergies (also for vegetarian). As in every ESC placement, volunteers receive insurance, pre-departure and on-arrival training, a mentor, language support and a Youthpass certificate.

about.en:
You will gain valuable experience in sustainable agriculture by hands on work at a organic dynamic softfruit farm by being actively involved in daily farm tasks. With the experience you gain you will also choose personal projects around the theme sustanibility. This could be organizing community events that promote sustainability or design educational program for schoolchildren on nature and environmental care or other things around these subjects that interest you. This project is highly relevant in today’s world, as it empowers young people to actively contribute to a greener, more sustainable future. By promoting eco-friendly practices and raising awareness, we are shaping a better tomorrow for our planet. Goals for this project: - Build a Greener Future Together. - Design a Space for Learning and Growth. - Promote Creativity and Collaboration. - Build Sustainable Partnerships. - To Enhance European Values like solidarity, cooperation, and sustainability.

Practical details: European Solidarity Corps individual volunteering hosted by Stichting Explosief Natuurschoon in Ingen, Netherlands; activity period 35 weeks within 1 March 2027 – 31 October 2027. Themes: food security and environment and nature. Application deadline: 30 November 2026. Open to young people aged 18–30 resident in 24 eligible countries (see eligibility).

Living and learning: We offer on-site accommodation, on the farm where the most activities take place. Volunteers have their own private room. Kitchen and bathrooms are shared, which also makes space for shared meals and connection, camping style life. We provide bikes for getting around and exploring the area. You’ll also receive a Dutch public transport card, which you can use for project- related travel and personal trips. As in every ESC placement, volunteers receive insurance, pre-departure and on-arrival training, a mentor, language support and a Youthpass certificate.

about.en:
The National Gallery of Armenia (NGA) was founded in 1921, is the country’s major art gallery. NGA has about 40 000 pieces of art. The program is aimed at discovering its collection as well as the masterpieces by the renowned artists exhibited in the leading world museums. The volunteers are given an opportunity to get an aesthetic education in specific museum atmosphere and to spend eventful time. Thematic- interactive, educational programs are organized for children including film and cartoon viewing, workshops. The volunteer will assist the excursion department.The work will be entertaining and educational. The volunteer will discover painters, treasures, learn the history of the art and the science of museology in general. The volunteer will be given a task to moderate social media pages. The project is organised by the support of HUJ-Voluntary Service of Armenia. The duration of the project is 8-12 months.

Practical details: European Solidarity Corps individual volunteering hosted by National Gallery of Armenia in Yerevan, Armenia; activity period 52 weeks within 1 February 2027 – 31 January 2028. Themes: culture and creativity. Application deadline: 1 January 2027. Open to young people aged 18–30 resident in 23 eligible countries (see eligibility).

Living and learning: The volunteers will be provided with convenient accommodation: the dormitory of a university in Yerevan, near the city center, featuring same-gendered rooms with two occupants each, shared bathroom, and a spacious kitchen. This cozy dormitory is equipped with all necessities and ensures safety. Approximately 18 long-term ESC volunteers from different European countries reside in the dormitory. As in every ESC placement, volunteers receive insurance, pre-departure and on-arrival training, a mentor, language support and a Youthpass certificate.

about.en:
Houens Odde Scout Centre is a conference and outdoor centre owned by the YMCA Scouts in Denmark. It is run by a mixed team of permanent employees as well as Danish and international volunteers. The centre also has a staff of around 120 Danish volunteer scouts from various scout organisations in Denmark. This team, called "Houmen", manages the scout events taking place at the centre throughout the year. Our guests include companies, schools, municipalities, NGOs, and scouts from both Denmark and abroad. The tasks are mainly practical, outdoor assignments focused on the daily operations of the centre. However, you will also act as a teambuilding instructor and assist in the kitchen/canteen. The practical work is designed so that anyone can participate, regardless of prior experience. There will also be opportunities to join scout summer camps as staff members and to work on a personal project focusing on inclusion/diversity and green policies

Practical details: European Solidarity Corps individual volunteering hosted by KFUM Spejderne I Denmark in Kolding, Denmark; activity period 1 August 2027 – 31 August 2028. Themes: environment and nature and education and training. Application deadline: 15 January 2027. Open to young people aged 18–30 resident in 22 eligible countries (see eligibility).

Living and learning: Volunteers share a large apartment located directly at the centre with room for up to 6 people. Each volunteer gets their own private bedroom, while sharing the kitchen, living room, and laundry facilities. The ESC volunteers will live alongside 2 Danish volunteers and 1 non-European volunteer. You do not need to be a scout to volunteer here. The centre covers all costs for accommodation and food. Additionally, the volunteers have access to 2 shared cars for both work purposes and free time. As in every ESC placement, volunteers receive insurance, pre-departure and on-arrival training, a mentor, language support and a Youthpass certificate.

You do not have to be a scout, but you should enjoy outdoor life, as the centre is located in the countryside, surrounded by forest and water. about.en:
National Youth Forum is the biggest youth organizations’ platform in Bulgaria. Our mission is to represent the interests of the young people and their interest, bringing the importance of youth organizations, their development and participation in socio-political processes, and ensuring an effective structured dialogue through cooperation with relevant stakeholders and decision-makers in youth policy. The selected participants are going to be in real-life media at our website: We are looking for young people who enjoy creating audio, visual, and text content, working with graphic software, managing posting plans on social networks, preparing a e-newsletter, preparing and executing campaigns, and creating content (sharing ideas for content). Who want to organize, promote and participate in various youth activities in line with NYF’s plans such as events, partner meetings, campaigns, and conferences, to communicate with partners and stakeholders.

about.en:
Solidarity Tracks is looking for long term volunteers (8 months) in Lefkas island, in order to introduce youngsters of the region to an intercultural approach of Sustainable development, share with them a common culture of sustainable development, and encourage them to implement awareness campaigns about different areas of sustainable development. Tasks examples: - Design, prepare and organize socio-educational workshops, outdoor activities and events for local citizens (youngsters and adults) such as: learning how to sort and use domestic waste, and reduce plastic consumption in our region; creating ecological and socio-educational furniture and games from wood and wooden pallets and recovered objects for kindergarten, primary schools and specialized schools for people with disability; Helping to develop abandoned public spaces in various disadvantaged villages in the region; participating regularly to beach and paths cleaning events; etc.

Practical details: European Solidarity Corps individual volunteering hosted by Solidarity Tracks in Lefkada, Greece; activity period 1 December 2026 – 21 March 2027. Themes: education and training and environment and nature. Application deadline: 30 November 2026. Open to young people aged 18–30 resident in 21 eligible countries (see eligibility).

Living and learning: The Volunteering project will take place in Lefkada island. The Volunteers home is in the centre of the town, very close to bars, restaurants, shops and close to the seaside as well. The home consists of 3 rooms (each room is shared by 2 volunteers, total 6 volunteers in the volunteer house). In case, the house is not available, volunteers will be hosted in another shared flat/studio for 2-3 persons. As in every ESC placement, volunteers receive insurance, pre-departure and on-arrival training, a mentor, language support and a Youthpass certificate.

about.en:
Nibble Stiftelsen runs different operations and activities. A central factor is the “Järna Naturbruks-gymnasium”. This is a 3 year high school offering a training program for green professions. Students participate in practical work in all areas. An important part of the school is the boarding school. The school/farm staff are international, with 7 countries represented. Nibble Farm is situated on the banks of the Baltic in a beautiful landscape. Activities at Nibble include, among others: -Nibble Handelsträdgård, a market garden and small holding with three hectares of fields, animals as well as green houses and shops. -Nibble Skog and Såg, forestry and a small scale saw mill. At Nibble we practice reality-based farming, gardening and more. We do this in the context of a training and education program. We collaborate with other local organisations and businesses with the goal of strengthening the local community and its resilience in a time of dramatic changes.

Practical details: European Solidarity Corps individual volunteering hosted by Nibble Stiftelsen in Järna, Sweden; activity period 34 weeks within 30 March 2027 – 26 November 2027. Themes: education and training and environment and nature. Application deadline: 23 March 2027. Open to young people aged 18–30 resident in 20 eligible countries (see eligibility).

Living and learning: Volunteers will have their own room in a special two room appartment on the farm. 3 meals a day are served weekdays during the school year. Volunteers will have access to their own kitchen for weekends and school holidays. Food is available from on site stocks, the farmshop and an allowance for purchases in town. Bicycles are provided and there is easy access to public transport (Stockholm appr 1,5 hrs). A car is available for special cases. As in every ESC placement, volunteers receive insurance, pre-departure and on-arrival training, a mentor, language support and a Youthpass certificate.

The European Volunteer will support the Director and Project Coordinator in the daily coordination and and the two permanent staff members implementation of JRS Luxembourg’s social inclusion programmes. This includes assisting with the Deng Plaz project, dedicated to recently arrived young migrants aged 13 to 17, providing french lessons, orientation, individual support, and access to social, educational and community activities. The EV will also contribute to the Solidarity French Courses open to all JRS beneficiaries and the Ubuntu Project, which provides a safe and supportive space for migrants and asylum seekers through psychosocial support and recretional activities . The EV will help welcome beneficiaries and volunteers, organise activities, support registrations, prepare materials, coordinate logistics, assist with administrative follow-up, and contribute to the smooth running of all projets.

about.en:
Located in northern Netherlands, DE PROEF is a unique heritage regeneration project where history, ecology, creativity, and community come together. As an EU Solidarity Corps volunteer, you'll be part of transforming this historic 140-year-old place (once a horticultural school) into a thriving hub for ecology, sustainable innovation, craftsmanship, and cultural exchange. We welcome enthusiastic, hands-on individuals, especially those interested in hospitality, horticulture, landscaping, ecology, and heritage conservation. No prior experience is required; just curiosity, a willingness to learn, and a love for plants and the outdoors!

Practical details: European Solidarity Corps individual volunteering hosted by DE Proef in Frederiksoord, Netherlands; activity period 13 weeks within 1 June 2027 – 31 August 2027. Themes: food security and environment and nature. No fixed deadline: the host recruits on a rolling basis while the placement is open on the portal. Open to young people aged 18–30 resident in 19 eligible countries (see eligibility).

Living and learning: What We Offer: 1. Accommodation – A private room in our residence, shared with a community of artists, designers, researchers, and fellow volunteers; 2. Meals Covered – We provide you with the essentials for cooking; 3. A Unique Experience – Live and work in a beautiful rural setting, explore Dutch horticultural heritage, and contribute to an inspiring project with real impact; 4. Some Pocket Money - To keep you going; 5. Travel Costs; 6. Time to spend on your own projects; 7. Learn new skills! As in every ESC placement, volunteers receive insurance, pre-departure and on-arrival training, a mentor, language support and a Youthpass certificate.

about.en:
Marca ADL is a local development association based in Montemor-o-Novo, a rural small city in Portugal. Marca ADL mission is centered on the Promotion of the social and economic development of rural regions, in particular the municipality of Montemor-o-Novo in conjunction with other territories, seeking solutions to local and global problems, involving and bringing citizens and institutions closer together in the search for solutions that promote sustainability and improve the quality of life of the population. Since 2015 Marca ADL most proeminent activity is developed around the Mediterranean Ecosystem Conservation Center, where we promote investigation, conservation and education activities around Mediterranean Flora and its ecosystems. A plant nursery, where around 100 native species are produced, is the main infrastructure of this structural activity and involves daily operational works.

about.en:
SEEDS Iceland is an Icelandic non-governmental, non-profit volunteer organisation designed to promote intercultural understanding, environmental protection and awareness through nature conservation, social and cultural volunteer work in Iceland. As a volunteer you can support SEEDS in their international camps in one of the three roles that fits you best! 1)Environment Camp Leaders assist the Project Manager in planning, implementing and participating in SEEDS’ nature camps and learning camps in Iceland. 2) Photography Camp Leaders assist the Project Manager in planning, implementing and participating in SEEDS’ Photography, Social & Environmental Issues in Iceland Camps. 3) Based in the SEEDS office in Reykjavík, the Communications & PR Volunteer assists the Project Manager in facilitating communication links between staff and other volunteers (short and long-term) as well as local and partner organisations from other countries.

Practical details: European Solidarity Corps individual volunteering hosted by Stichting UcDean in Reykjavík, Iceland; activity period 12 weeks within 1 January 2027 – 19 December 2027. Themes: environment and nature and culture and creativity. No fixed deadline: the host recruits on a rolling basis while the placement is open on the portal. Open to young people aged 18–30 resident in 1 eligible countries (see eligibility).

Living and learning: Food is provided for everyone and the shopping is completed according to SEEDS’ standard shopping list, ensuring that every volunteer has a balanced diet. During the camps that take place outside of Reykjavík, the local project coordinator will be in charge of providing the food. Volunteers stay in a shared flat (max. four people per room) in Reykjavík and return there between camps. They will most likely stay close to the centre of Reykjavík, where they can relax during their free time. As in every ESC placement, volunteers receive insurance, pre-departure and on-arrival training, a mentor, language support and a Youthpass certificate.

about.en:
L’association des Scouts tunisiens de Sfax (nom complet : groupe local de scouts tunisiens Hay Habib, association laïque) a été créée en 1976. Elle a pour objectif d’assurer des activités de scoutisme et une animation socio-éducative pour une meilleure préparation à la vie des enfants et des jeunes âgé·es de 6 à 17 ans. La mission: -Sensibiliser les enfants et les jeunes scouts à l’écologie et au développement durable, en soutenant l’entretien et la valorisation des espaces verts du local (« poste de verdure », plantations, tri des déchets). -Favoriser l’émancipation et le développement personnel des enfants et des jeunes en animant des activités socio-éducatives, culturelles et citoyennes au sein du mouvement scout et des établissements scolaires partenaires. (Animer des activités éducatives, culturelles et citoyennes auprès des enfants, jeunes, au sein du local scout) Ces missions sont évolutives. Elles seront réadaptées à la structure et au·à la volontaire, une fois sur place.

Themes: environment and nature and education and training. No fixed deadline: the host recruits on a rolling basis while the placement is open on the portal. Open to young people aged 18–30 resident in 1 eligible countries (see eligibility).

Living and learning: Logement : un logement en colocation avec d'autres volontaires à Sfax est mis à disposition au.à la volontaire. Transport AR jusqu’au lieu de mission : prise en charge du trajet aller-retour selon forfait kilométrique (maximum 309€ aller-retour). Indemnité : l’indemnité mensuelle du Corps Européen de Solidarité dépend du pays de mission. En Tunisie, l'indemnité est de 330€/mois : 180€ pour l’alimentation et 150€ d’argent de poche. As in every ESC placement, volunteers receive insurance, pre-departure and on-arrival training, a mentor, language support and a Youthpass certificate.

Créée en 2016, l’association Espace Espoir Guercif agit auprès des femmes, des jeunes, des enfants et des familles en situation de vulnérabilité en intervenant sur l’autonomisation économique des femmes, la prévention et l’accompagnement face aux violences fondées sur le genre, l’alphabétisation et la post-alphabétisation, la formation professionnelle, l’inclusion numérique, l’éducation non formelle et la participation citoyenne. Objectif de la mission : Soutenir les actions éducatives, citoyennes et d'autonomisation auprès des femmes et des jeunes et la valorisation des activités de l'association, coanimer des activités d’apprentissage du français, de soutien scolaire, de jeux éducatifs, d’ateliers créatifs et de découverte interculturelle; mener des ateliers d’initiation à la bureautique, la recherche d’information, la sécurité numérique, les outils de communication auprès des femmes et des jeunes de Guercif etc Les missions sont évolutives

about.en:
L'association d'accueil des volontaires CES est Torraha. Son nom évoque à la fois le filet de pêche et la tenue traditionnelle des femmes d’Alexandrie, deux piliers culturels majeurs. Torraha se consacre à la création, à l'organisation et à la gestion de programmes culturels innovants. En utilisant l'art comme levier de développement, elle offre des opportunités uniques aux personnes défavorisées. Danse, musique, littérature – autant de domaines explorés pour construire un avenir équilibré et dynamique. Tel un filet tissé avec soin, Torraha relie les éléments du passé au présent, unissant ainsi culture et progrès. Son engagement à promouvoir un développement inclusif propulse cette association vers un avenir où la richesse artistique se mêle harmonieusement à l'amélioration de la société.

Cette chambre sera située dans un appartement partagé avec d’autres jeunes. - Votre indemnité mensuelle couvrira le loyer de la chambre ainsi que les factures d’électricité, d’eau et de gaz. - En tant que bénévole, vous travaillerez 35 heures par semaine. Vous aurez droit à 2 jours de repos hebdomadaire ainsi qu’à 2 jours de repos par mois. As in every ESC placement, volunteers receive insurance, pre-departure and on-arrival training, a mentor, language support and a Youthpass certificate.

about.en:
Rainfer Sanctuary is, since 1995, a rescue and rehabilitation centre for primates that have been subjected to human exploitation (illegal trade, circuses, zoos that kept them in poor conditions or are abandoned pets). Our main aims are fighting against illegal trade of wildlife, raising environmental awareness in the society through education and taking care of primates sheltered in our facilities (we shelter and take care of over 125 primates of over 20 different species). We are now seeking for European Solidarity Corps volunteers eager to learn and take part in animal conservation. Volunteers will collaborate with our professional caretakers in Sanctuary’s daily tasks such as: elaboration of primate diets; small and medium-sized monkey feeding; hygiene and disinfection of primate facilities; elaboration of enrichment techniques for physical and psychological rehabilitation of primates or development of ethological observation of primate groups.

Practical details: European Solidarity Corps individual volunteering hosted by Fundación Rainfer in Alcobendas, Spain; activity period 23 November 2026 – 23 November 2027. Themes: environment and nature. Application deadline: 20 November 2026. Open to young people aged 18–30 resident in 32 eligible countries (see eligibility).

Living and learning: Volunteers will be accommodated on site in a fully equipped bungalow with 4 double bedrooms with ensuite bathroom, kitchen and dining room. Volunteers are responsible for keeping it clean, however our cleaning personnel will help keep the area in good conditions. The Sanctuary is a 30-minutes’ walk from the closest village, where all basic shops and equipments can be found. Madrid can be accessed by bus in their spare time, 2 bikes are available for volunteers. As in every ESC placement, volunteers receive insurance, pre-departure and on-arrival training, a mentor, language support and a Youthpass certificate.

about.en:
Join our ESC volunteering project in Sinop, Türkiye, and turn your passion for animals into hands-on experience! 🐾 Volunteers will support the daily care and welfare of around 110 cats and several dogs living in our Patient Room, village house and garden. Tasks include feeding, cleaning, administering medication, parasite treatments, caring for sick, disabled and orphaned animals, and monitoring their health. A key part of the activity takes place at Gerze Municipality Stray Animal Care Centre, where volunteers work alongside veterinary professionals and gain practical experience by observing and assisting with procedures such as examinations, treatments, spay/neuter surgeries and other operations. This is an intensive, hands-on opportunity for veterinary students, young veterinarians and veterinary nurses who want to develop their skills while making a real difference in the lives of animals.

Practical details: European Solidarity Corps individual volunteering hosted by Sahipsiz Hayvanlari Koruma ve Yasatma Dernegi in Merkez, Türkiye; activity period 40 weeks within 16 November 2026 – 13 September 2027. Themes: environment and nature. No fixed deadline: the host recruits on a rolling basis while the placement is open on the portal. Open to young people aged 18–30 resident in 30 eligible countries (see eligibility).

Living and learning: Volunteers will stay in a furnished shared house in Sinop with Wi-Fi, hot water, heating, kitchen, bed linen and basic household facilities. Long-term volunteers have a private room, while short-term volunteers may share. A daily food allowance of €6 and pocket money of €6 are provided in cash. Transport between Sinop and the activity locations in Gerze and Bektaşağa Village is covered by the organisation. As in every ESC placement, volunteers receive insurance, pre-departure and on-arrival training, a mentor, language support and a Youthpass certificate.

about.en:
World Youth Day (WYD) is the international gathering of young people founded by Pope John Paul II; WYD Seoul 2027 runs 3–8 August 2027 and organisers expect around 500,000 participants and roughly 30,000 volunteers. Short-term volunteers of the Local Organizing Committee serve on site during the event in roles such as pilgrim services, logistics, venues, language support and medical teams.

The volunteer programme starts one week before the main event (from 27 July 2027) with training and a Volunteer Commissioning Mass, and volunteers are expected to be in Seoul from about 26 July to 9 August. The process is: online application, online training, interview, selection, then choosing and paying for a Volunteer Package that includes insurance, a transport card, volunteer kit, accommodation and meals.

It is open regardless of nationality, religion or disability, and is a rare chance to work inside one of the largest youth events in the world, in an international team, with an official certificate of service.

en: One of the largest international youth events in the world, in Seoul (3–8 August 2027)

eligibility.en: Born on or before 31 December 2008 (Korean Youth Protection Act); any nationality, religion or disability; able to communicate in at least one official WYD language (Korean, English, Spanish, French, Portuguese or Italian); must take part in all training from 27 July 2027. A recommendation letter from a Catholic priest or religious (same form for all religions) and ID are required; applicants who need a Korean visa must upload it.

en: Read the volunteer page and FAQ on wydseoul.org.

Complete the online training and interview.
If selected, choose a Volunteer Package and pay the contribution, then arrange visa and travel.

costs.en: Selected volunteers pay for a Volunteer Package (amount published in the registration system) covering accommodation, meals, insurance, transport card and volunteer kit. International travel and visa are at your own cost. Long-term international volunteers (6+ months, separate track) receive accommodation and partial meal and transport support.

name.ar: ماراثون طوكيو 2027 — المتطوعون الدوليون (Global Volunteers)

duration.en: Race day 7 March 2027 (plus check-in and briefing 4–6 March)
duration.ka: რბოლის დღე — 7 მარტი, 2027 (რეგისტრაცია და ბრიფინგი 4–6 მარტს)
duration.ar: يوم السباق 7 مارس 2027 (مع التسجيل والإحاطة 4–6 مارس)

deadline_note: Official Global Volunteer guideline: entry closes 23 November 2026, 17:00 JST (first come, first served; dates may change without notice).

summary.en: Volunteers from overseas can join the Tokyo Marathon 2027 team at aid stations and the finish area on race day, 7 March 2027. Places are first come, first served; register as a VOLUNTAINER overseas member and enter by 23 November 2026.
summary.ka: უცხოელ მოხალისეებს შეუძლიათ ტოკიოს მარათონის 2027 გუნდს შეუერთდნენ კვების პუნქტებსა და ფინიშის ზონაში რბოლის დღეს, 7 მარტს. ადგილები ნაწილდება რიგითობით; დარეგისტრირდით VOLUNTAINER-ის საზღვარგარეთის წევრად და გაგზავნეთ განაცხადი 23 ნოემბრამდე, 2026.
summary.ar: يمكن للمتطوعين من خارج اليابان الانضمام إلى فريق ماراثون طوكيو 2027 في محطات الإمداد ومنطقة خط النهاية يوم السباق، 7 مارس 2027. تُمنح الأماكن حسب الأسبقية؛ سجّل عضوًا خارجيًا في VOLUNTAINER وقدّم طلبك قبل 23 نوفمبر 2026.

about.en:
The Tokyo Marathon is one of the six Abbott World Marathon Majors. For the 2027 race (Sunday 7 March 2027) the Tokyo Marathon Foundation recruits "Global Volunteers" from overseas through VOLUNTAINER, its official volunteer club, as part of a team of about 10,000 volunteers.

Global Volunteers hand out water, sports drinks, snacks and sponges at aid stations along the course (blocks from Suidobashi and Kanda to Ginza, Asakusa and Shiba) or distribute items to runners at the finish near Tokyo Station, usually between about 8:00 and 18:00. Before the race each volunteer must attend in-person check-in and the mandatory information session at Tokyo Big Sight (4, 5 or 6 March 2027). Assignments are announced in mid-January 2027.

Volunteers receive official volunteer wear and a cap, and a certificate of activity on request. It is a short, low-commitment way to be part of a world-class sporting event and meet volunteers from many countries.

en: Be part of a World Marathon Major in central Tokyo on 7 March 2027
Dedicated entry for overseas residents; English is the working language for Global Volunteers
Free to join; official volunteer wear and activity certificate

eligibility.en: Aged 18 or over; registered VOLUNTAINER (overseas) member; able to attend the check-in and mandatory briefing in Tokyo on 4, 5 or 6 March 2027. One entry per person. The organisers do not issue visa documents, so check Japan's entry rules for your nationality.

en: Create a VOLUNTAINER Overseas Membership account at voluntainer.jp (English available).
Read the Global Volunteer guideline on marathon.tokyo.
Submit the Global Volunteer entry form before 23 November 2026, 17:00 JST (first come, first served).
Wait for the selection email; contact the VOLUNTAINER office if you hear nothing within two weeks.
Check your block assignment in mid-January and activity details in mid-February 2027.

costs.en: No fee. Volunteer wear and cap are provided. Travel to Japan, accommodation, meals and drinks are at your own expense.

score_reason: Prestigious, free and easy to join, but travel is self-funded and it is a single-day role

org: IIHF World Championship 2027 Organizing Committee (German Ice Hockey Federation)

name.en: IIHF Ice Hockey World Championship 2027 (Germany): Volunteer Programme
name.ka: ჰოკეის მსოფლიო ჩემპიონატი IIHF 2027 (გერმანია) — მოხალისეთა პროგრამა
name.ar: بطولة العالم لهوكي الجليد IIHF 2027 (ألمانيا) — برنامج المتطوعين

deadline_note: Registration is open on the official volunteer platform (no closing date published); organisers aim to confirm selections by the end of 2026, so apply now. Gelsenkirchen registration opens later.

summary.en: Join the volunteer team of the 2027 Ice Hockey World Championship in Düsseldorf and Mannheim, the world's largest annual winter sports event. Volunteers aged 18+ commit to at least 7 days and receive meals, uniform, a certificate and at least one game ticket.
summary.ka: შეუერთდით 2027 წლის ჰოკეის მსოფლიო ჩემპიონატის მოხალისეთა გუნდს დიუსელდორფსა და მანჰაიმში — მსოფლიოში უდიდეს ყოველწლიურ ზამთრის სპორტულ ღონისძიებას. 18+ ასაკის მოხალისეები მინიმუმ 7 დღით ერთვებიან და იღებენ კვებას, ფორმას, სერტიფიკატს და მინიმუმ ერთ ბილეთს.
summary.ar: انضم إلى فريق متطوعي بطولة العالم لهوكي الجليد 2027 في دوسلدورف ومانهايم، أكبر حدث رياضي شتوي سنوي في العالم. يلتزم المتطوعون (18+) بسبعة أيام على الأقل ويحصلون على الوجبات والزي وشهادة وتذكرة مباراة واحدة على الأقل.

about.en:
Germany hosts the IIHF Ice Hockey World Championship from 14 to 30 May 2027 in Düsseldorf and Mannheim (with one game in Gelsenkirchen). The organising committee is recruiting volunteers for roles such as hospitality, transport, accreditation and fan services, both in the lead-up to and during the tournament, with structured orientation and training before your first shift.

Volunteers must be 18 by 1 May 2027, have a smartphone and email, and be available for at least 7 days (longer availability is preferred). You can list three preferred work areas. Applicants from abroad are expressly welcome, but very good German is mandatory (English is a plus).

Benefits include meals on volunteer days, volunteer clothing you keep, a volunteer certificate, access to the Home of Volunteers lounge and at least one game ticket. It is a strong CV line for students interested in sport management, events or tourism.

en: World's largest annual winter sports event, Düsseldorf and Mannheim, 14–30 May 2027
International applicants welcome (German required)
Meals, uniform, certificate and at least one game ticket

eligibility.en: Aged 18+ by 1 May 2027; available for at least 7 days; very good German required, English an advantage; valid email address and smartphone; must attend the kick-off meeting and training. Non-residents of Germany may apply but must arrange their own travel, lodging and accident insurance.

en: Read the volunteer overview and both FAQs on iihf.com.
Create an account on the official volunteer platform (iihf.eventvolunteers.de).
Choose your city (Düsseldorf and/or Mannheim), availability and three preferred work areas.
Wait for the selection decision (expected by the end of 2026), then attend kick-off and training.

costs.en: Free. Meals during shifts, volunteer clothing, a certificate and at least one game ticket are provided. Travel, lodging and accident insurance are the volunteer's responsibility.

score_reason: Big international sport event, open to foreigners, but German required and travel self-funded

name.en: Expo 2027 Belgrade: "Expo Playmakers" Volunteer Programme
name.ka: ექსპო 2027 ბელგრადი — მოხალისეთა პროგრამა „Expo Playmakers“
name.ar: إكسبو 2027 بلغراد — برنامج المتطوعين «Expo Playmakers»

duration.en: At least 15 days during the 93-day Expo (15 May – 15 August 2027)
duration.ka: მინიმუმ 15 დღე 93-დღიანი ექსპოს განმავლობაში (15 მაისი – 15 აგვისტო, 2027)
duration.ar: 15 يومًا على الأقل خلال إكسبو الممتد 93 يومًا (15 مايو – 15 أغسطس 2027)

deadline_note: Applications opened 15 May 2026 and were reported still open on 21 August 2026; no closing date published, and recruitment and training run mainly September 2026 – April 2027.

summary.en: Expo 2027 Belgrade is recruiting 20,000 "Expo Playmakers" from Serbia and abroad to welcome visitors and national delegations at the specialised world exhibition. Volunteers serve at least 15 days and receive training, uniform and a BIE-endorsed certificate.
summary.ka: ექსპო 2027 ბელგრადი ეძებს 20 000 მოხალისეს („Expo Playmakers“) სერბეთიდან და საზღვარგარეთიდან სტუმრებისა და ქვეყნების დელეგაციების მისაღებად. მოხალისეები მუშაობენ მინიმუმ 15 დღე და იღებენ ტრენინგს, ფორმას და BIE-ს მიერ აღიარებულ სერტიფიკატს.
summary.ar: يبحث إكسبو 2027 بلغراد عن 20 ألف متطوع «Expo Playmakers» من صربيا والخارج لاستقبال الزوار والوفود الوطنية في المعرض الدولي المتخصص. يخدم المتطوعون 15 يومًا على الأقل ويحصلون على تدريب وزي رسمي وشهادة معتمدة من BIE.

about.en:
Expo 2027 Belgrade is a specialised World Expo recognised by the Bureau International des Expositions (BIE), running for 93 days in 2027 under the theme "Play for Humanity: Sport and Music for All". Its volunteer programme, Expo Playmakers, is the largest in Serbia's history, with 48 roles including visitor and delegation services, logistics, event operations and support for international teams.

The programme is open to adults from Serbia and abroad (applicants must be 18 by 15 April 2027) who can serve at least 15 days during the Expo. More than 10,000 people from 119 countries had applied by August 2026. Selected volunteers receive general and specialised training, including multicultural communication.

Benefits include an official uniform and welcome pack, a certificate endorsed by the BIE, extra ECTS credits for students, Air Serbia flight discounts of up to 27%, and free rides on selected Srbijavoz trains in Serbia. Accommodation is not mentioned, so international volunteers should plan their own stay.

en: World Expo volunteering in Belgrade, open to international applicants
Minimum 15 days; 48 different roles
BIE-endorsed certificate, ECTS credits and Air Serbia flight discounts

eligibility.en: Adults of any nationality who are 18 by 15 April 2027 and available for at least 15 days during the Expo. Check Serbia's visa rules for your passport before applying.

en: Create an account on the official volunteer portal (join.volunteer.expobelgrade2027.org).
Fill in the application with your availability, languages and preferred roles.
Complete the selection steps and the general and specialised training (mainly autumn 2026 – spring 2027).
Questions: playmakers@expobelgrade2027.org.

costs.en: Free. Uniform, welcome package, training and certificate provided; up to 27% off Air Serbia flights and free selected Srbijavoz trains. Accommodation and meals are not stated as covered.

score_reason: Huge, international, free and recognised by the BIE; close to Georgia and visa-friendly

name.en: FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027: Volunteer Programme
name.ka: FIFA-ს ქალთა მსოფლიო ჩემპიონატი ბრაზილია 2027 — მოხალისეთა პროგრამა
name.ar: كأس العالم للسيدات FIFA البرازيل 2027 — برنامج المتطوعين

deadline_note: FIFA opened applications on 3 September 2026 "for a limited period of time" without a published closing date; still accepting as of FIFA's 8 October 2026 update. Apply as early as possible.

summary.en: FIFA is recruiting more than 6,000 volunteers for the first Women's World Cup in South America, across eight Brazilian host cities in June–July 2027. Applicants must be 18+, speak Portuguese or English and be able to enter Brazil.
summary.ka: FIFA ეძებს 6000-ზე მეტ მოხალისეს სამხრეთ ამერიკაში პირველი ქალთა მსოფლიო ჩემპიონატისთვის — ბრაზილიის რვა მასპინძელ ქალაქში, 2027 წლის ივნის–ივლისში. აპლიკანტები უნდა იყვნენ 18+, ფლობდნენ პორტუგალიურს ან ინგლისურს და ჰქონდეთ ბრაზილიაში შესვლის უფლება.
summary.ar: تبحث FIFA عن أكثر من 6000 متطوع لأول كأس عالم للسيدات في أمريكا الجنوبية، في ثماني مدن برازيلية مضيفة خلال يونيو–يوليو 2027. يجب أن يكون المتقدم بعمر 18+ ويتحدث البرتغالية أو الإنجليزية ويحق له دخول البرازيل.

about.en:
The FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027 will be played in Belo Horizonte, Brasília, Fortaleza, Porto Alegre, Recife, Rio de Janeiro, Salvador and São Paulo. FIFA opened volunteer applications on 3 September 2026 and plans to recruit more than 6,000 volunteers; over 100,000 people had registered interest, and shortlisted applicants are invited to interviews on a rolling basis.

Volunteers must be 18 or over, Brazilian or legally permitted to enter Brazil for the tournament, available for seven to ten shifts in June–July 2027, and speak Portuguese or English (other languages are a plus). No previous volunteering experience is required. Selected volunteers receive training and support from experienced staff.

Benefits include meals during shifts, a full adidas uniform, transport within the host city and recognition gifts. Note that only the application on volunteer.fifa.com counts; earlier "register your interest" sign-ups are not applications.

en: First Women's World Cup in South America, eight host cities
No experience needed; Portuguese or English required
Meals, adidas uniform and local transport provided

eligibility.en: Aged 18+ at the time of application; Brazilian national or legally permitted to enter Brazil during the tournament; available for 7–10 shifts in June–July 2027; Portuguese or English essential.

en: Join or log in to the FIFA Volunteer Community at volunteer.fifa.com.
Select the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027 and complete the application form.
Complete the short online assessment.
If shortlisted, attend the interview and training.

costs.en: Free. Meals on shift, adidas uniform and transport within the host city provided. International travel and accommodation are not covered.

score_reason: Global flagship event, free, but travel self-funded and application window may close soon

org: Department of Conservation (Te Papa Atawhai), New Zealand

name.en: Department of Conservation (DOC) Volunteering, New Zealand
name.ka: ახალი ზელანდიის კონსერვაციის დეპარტამენტის (DOC) მოხალისეობა
name.ar: التطوع مع إدارة الحفاظ على البيئة (DOC) في نيوزيلندا

duration.en: From a single day to several weeks, year-round
duration.ka: ერთი დღიდან რამდენიმე კვირამდე, მთელი წლის განმავლობაში
duration.ar: من يوم واحد إلى عدة أسابيع، على مدار السنة

deadline_note: Rolling: DOC lists volunteer activities year-round by region, type, time commitment and fitness level.

summary.en: New Zealand's official conservation agency offers volunteer activities across the country, from tree planting and pest control to hut and track work. International visitors already in New Zealand can join without a work visa as long as the role is unpaid.
summary.ka: ახალი ზელანდიის ოფიციალური კონსერვაციის სააგენტო მთელ ქვეყანაში სთავაზობს მოხალისეობრივ აქტივობებს — ხეების დარგვიდან მავნებლების კონტროლამდე და ბილიკებზე მუშაობამდე. ქვეყანაში მყოფ უცხოელ სტუმრებს შეუძლიათ ჩაერთონ სამუშაო ვიზის გარეშე, თუ როლი ანაზღაურებადი არ არის.
summary.ar: تتيح الجهة الرسمية للحفاظ على البيئة في نيوزيلندا أنشطة تطوعية في أنحاء البلاد، من زراعة الأشجار ومكافحة الآفات إلى صيانة الأكواخ والمسارات. ويمكن للزوار الأجانب الموجودين في نيوزيلندا المشاركة دون تأشيرة عمل طالما أن الدور غير مدفوع.

about.en:
The Department of Conservation (DOC) manages New Zealand's national parks and protected areas and runs a large volunteer programme. On its website you can search volunteer activities by region, type, time commitment and fitness level; some are run by DOC directly and others by community conservation groups linked from the listings.

International visitors can volunteer if they are already in New Zealand and allowed to stay for the length of the activity; no work visa is needed because the roles are unpaid. Some roles need a police certificate (in English), and DOC strongly recommends comprehensive travel insurance.

It is a good option for gap-year students, working-holiday visitors and anyone studying environmental science who wants hands-on fieldwork with an official agency.

en: Official government conservation volunteering in national parks
Open to international visitors in New Zealand; no work visa needed for unpaid roles
Filter by region, duration and fitness level

eligibility.en: Anyone who is in New Zealand and permitted to stay for the length of the activity; age and fitness requirements depend on the activity. Some roles require a police certificate.

en: Browse volunteer activities on doc.govt.nz by region, type and time commitment.
Read "Choosing a suitable volunteer activity" and the international volunteers page.
Apply or register through the activity listing (DOC or the community group running it).
Arrange travel insurance and, if requested, a police certificate.

costs.en: Volunteering is free. Travel to New Zealand, insurance and living costs are yours; some longer DOC roles may provide accommodation (check each listing).

score_reason: Official and free, but you must already be in New Zealand

name.en: Habitat for Humanity Global Village: Healthy homes build in Quetzaltenango, Guatemala (January 2027)
name.ka: Habitat for Humanity Global Village — ჯანსაღი სახლები, Quetzaltenango (გვატემალა), იანვარი 2027
name.ar: Habitat for Humanity Global Village — منازل صحية في Quetzaltenango، غواتيمالا (يناير 2027)

deadline_note: No fixed deadline: registration through the team leader stays open until the team (usually 12–24 people) is full, so contact the leader early.

summary.en: A one-week Habitat for Humanity Global Village build in Quetzaltenango, Guatemala (23 January 2027 – 30 January 2027). Volunteers help Habitat Guatemala install cement floors, healthy-home kits and smokeless stoves in rural homes, where most families still cook over open fires indoors. The programme donation of US$2,560 covers on-site accommodation, meals and transport; flights are extra.
summary.ka: ერთკვირიანი სამშენებლო მოხალისეობა Habitat for Humanity-სთან — Quetzaltenango, გვატემალა (23 იანვარი, 2027 – 30 იანვარი, 2027): მოხალისეები ადგილობრივ ოჯახებთან ერთად აუმჯობესებენ სახლებს (უკვამლო ღუმელები, ბეტონის იატაკი, სანიტარია). პროგრამის შემოწირულობა (US$2,560) ფარავს საცხოვრებელს, კვებას და ადგილობრივ ტრანსპორტს; ავიაბილეთი ცალკეა.
summary.ar: أسبوع تطوع في البناء مع Habitat for Humanity في Quetzaltenango، غواتيمالا (23 يناير 2027 – 30 يناير 2027): يحسّن المتطوعون المنازل (مواقد بلا دخان وأرضيات خرسانية وصرف صحي) مع الأسر المحلية. يغطي التبرع البرنامجي (US$2,560) السكن والوجبات والتنقل المحلي، بينما تذاكر الطيران على حساب المشارك.

about.en:
Global Village is Habitat for Humanity's week-long international volunteer programme. This open build in Quetzaltenango, Guatemala runs 23 January 2027 – 30 January 2027 (healthy homes). Volunteers help Habitat Guatemala install cement floors, healthy-home kits and smokeless stoves in rural homes, where most families still cook over open fires indoors.

Individual volunteers can join on their own or with friends; teams of 12–24 people are led by an experienced Habitat team leader. A typical itinerary is arrival day, a cultural or learning exchange, four build days working alongside a local contractor, families and community volunteers, a visit to other Habitat projects and a farewell, then departure. No construction or language skills are needed.

Costs: a programme donation of US$2,560 supports Habitat's housing work and covers your shared hotel room, meals and ground transport on site. International flights, travel insurance and visas are extra. Many volunteers fundraise the donation. Adults 18+; this build also accepts youth aged 15–17 if accompanied by a parent, legal guardian or authorised adult.

en: One-week healthy-homes upgrades build in Quetzaltenango, Guatemala (23 January 2027 – 30 January 2027)
Programme donation US$2,560 covers accommodation, meals and local transport; flights extra
Run by Habitat for Humanity, a major international housing non-profit; no skills required

eligibility.en: Open to individuals of any nationality who can obtain the necessary visa and are in good physical health (work can be strenuous). Adults 18+; this build also accepts youth aged 15–17 if accompanied by a parent, legal guardian or authorised adult.

en: Read the Global Village FAQs on habitat.org.
Open this build's page and email the team leader listed to confirm the trip suits you.
Register with the link the team leader sends you.
Pay the non-refundable deposit or start fundraising the programme donation, then book flights to arrive on the first day.

costs.en: Programme donation US$2,560 (accommodation in a shared double room, meals, ground transport and a contribution to the housing programme). Single rooms cost extra. International travel, insurance and visa fees are not included.

score_reason: Reputable non-profit, open to individuals and some teens, but costs about US$2–3k plus flights

name.en: Habitat for Humanity Global Village: Home construction build in Luque, Paraguay (February 2027)
name.ka: Habitat for Humanity Global Village — სახლების მშენებლობა, Luque (პარაგვაი), თებერვალი 2027
name.ar: Habitat for Humanity Global Village — بناء المنازل في Luque، باراغواي (فبراير 2027)

deadline_note: No fixed deadline: registration through the team leader stays open until the team (usually 12–24 people) is full, so contact the leader early.

summary.en: A one-week Habitat for Humanity Global Village build in Luque, Paraguay (27 February 2027 – 6 March 2027). Volunteers work with a contractor and local volunteers to build small two-bedroom modular homes (about 34 m²) with Habitat Paraguay, which has partnered with more than 10,000 families since 1996. about.en:
Global Village is Habitat for Humanity's week-long international volunteer programme. This open build in San Cristóbal, Dominican Republic runs 13 November 2027 – 20 November 2027 (critical home improvement). Volunteers replace dirt floors with concrete for older adults, mothers of young children and people with disabilities under the 100,000 Floors to Play initiative.

Individual volunteers can join on their own or with friends; teams of 12–24 people are led by an experienced Habitat team leader. A typical itinerary is arrival day, a cultural or learning exchange, four build days working alongside a local contractor, families and community volunteers, a visit to other Habitat projects and a farewell, then departure. No construction or language skills are needed.

Costs: a programme donation of US$2,245 supports Habitat's housing work and covers your shared hotel room, meals and ground transport on site. International flights, travel insurance and visas are extra. Many volunteers fundraise the donation. Adults 18+ only (this build does not accept volunteers under 18).
